sentences.text: William Henry Gates III -LRB- born October 28 , 1955 -RRB- is the co-founder of Microsoft and is an American business magnate , investor , author and philanthropist .	Microsoft	Microsoft
In 1975 , Gates and Paul Allen co-founded Microsoft , which became the world 's largest PC software company .	Microsoft	Microsoft	Paul Allen	Paul Allen	PC	Personal computer

During his career at Microsoft , Gates held the positions of chairman , CEO and chief software architect , while also being the largest individual shareholder until May 2014 .	Microsoft	Microsoft	CEO	CEO	chief software architect	software architect

Gates stepped down as chief executive officer of Microsoft in January 2000 , but he remained as chairman and created the position of chief software architect for himself .	Microsoft	Microsoft	chief software architect	software architect

In June 2006 , Gates announced that he would be transitioning from full-time work at Microsoft to part-time work and full-time work at the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation .	Microsoft	Microsoft	Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation	Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation	Melinda Gates	Melinda Gates
He gradually transferred his duties to Ray Ozzie and Craig Mundie .	Ray Ozzie	Ray Ozzie	Craig Mundie	Craig Mundie

He stepped down as chairman of Microsoft in February 2014 , taking on a new post as technology adviser to support the then newly appointed CEO Satya Nadella .	Microsoft	Microsoft	CEO	CEO	Satya Nadella	Satya Nadella
Gates is one of the best-known entrepreneurs of the personal computer revolution .	personal computer revolution	Home computer

He has been criticized for his business tactics , which have been considered anti-competitive , an opinion that has in some cases been upheld by numerous court rulings .	criticized for his business tactics	Criticism of Microsoft	anti-competitive	Anti-competitive practices

Later in his career , Gates pursued a number of philanthropic endeavors , donating large amounts of money to various charitable organizations and scientific research programs through the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation , established in 2000 .	Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation	Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation	Melinda Gates	Melinda Gates
Since 1987 , Gates has been included in the Forbes list of the world 's wealthiest people .
Gates is the richest person in the world , with an estimated net worth of US$ 88.5 billion .

In 2009 , Gates and Warren Buffett founded The Giving Pledge , whereby they and other billionaires pledge to give at least half of their wealth to philanthropy .	Warren Buffett	Warren Buffett	The Giving Pledge	The Giving Pledge
